description: This file defines a custom exception class 'FeignException' used for handling exceptions in the Feign HTTP client within the Apache Fineract project. It includes various constructors and methods for accessing exception details such as status code, request info, response body, and messages.

classes.name: FeignException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending RuntimeException, representing errors returned from Feign HTTP requests, containing relevant request and response data.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code associated with the exception.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Returns the Request object associated with the exception.

methods.name: responseBody
methods.description: Returns the response body as a byte array.

methods.name: responseBodyAsString
methods.description: Converts the response body byte array to a string using the default charset.

methods.name: getDeveloperMessage
methods.description: Returns a developer-specific message related to the exception, if set.

methods.name: getUserMessage
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly message related to the exception, if set.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Overrides the default message method to provide detailed exception information including status, user message, and developer message.
